study type: Comparative study (quasi-experimental or non-randomized clinical trial)
exposure: Budesonide (BUD) combined with bovine pulmonary surfactant (PS)
Ambroxol (AMB) combined with bovine pulmonary surfactant (PS)
outcome: Arterial blood gas index (PaO2, PaCO2, PaO2/FiO2)
cohort: The study included 90 children diagnosed with Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (NRDS) treated in a hospital between September 2019 and May 2020.
finding: Ambroxol (AMB) combined with bovine pulmonary surfactant (PS) was found to be superior to Budesonide (BUD) combined with PS in treating NRDS, showing higher effective rates, better blood gas, inflammatory, and oxidative stress indices, shorter treatment and symptom recovery times, and fewer complications, deaths, and repeated medications.
